soundness_flags.label: ass:finite-rational-context-grid, ass:rational-quantile-splines, and ass:rational-piecewise-payoff
soundness_flags.one_line: Exact finite rational grids, quantile splines, and payoffs are instrumental symbolic restrictions, and “externally validating” exact membership is not a credible real-data justification; either frame the work strictly as exact computation for supplied symbolic SCMs or add a quantified approximation/misspecification transfer.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 6, def:simultaneous-dkw-fiber, and Open-ended Question 7
soundness_flags.one_line: The fiber constrains sup_x|F'_v-\widehat F_v| for every cell although \widehat F_v is undefined when n_v=0; define an empty-cell convention making that constraint explicitly vacuous.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 7
soundness_flags.one_line: “Relevant true-law cell” is not defined; replace it with an explicit set such as \mathcal V_+(Q)=\{v:P_{obs}(Q)(c_v)>0\} and state the convergence event over that set.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Recast the exact-rational results as algorithms for a supplied symbolic SCM, or prove an explicit approximation theorem transferring endpoints and decisions from a physical law to a rational surrogate with a stated error budget.
Define \widehat F_v for n_v=0 and replace every use of “relevant cell” by a formally declared positive-visitation set.

Promote the projector OEQ by first proving a finite-knot extremal reduction or a modulus-of-continuity theorem for the coupled ratio objective, with a termination/complexity bound for the resulting refinement.
